landing.title: Stream widgets for OBS
landing.headline: Stream widgets that don't eat your CPU
landing.description: Chat, alerts, emote combos and scene screens. Pick a style, tweak animations and paste one link into OBS.
landing.welcomeBack: You're signed in. Your widgets are waiting.
landing.guestDescription: No account needed. Your widgets are kept in this browser.
landing.loginDescription: Sign in to keep your widgets on every device, upload sounds and get follow alerts.

obs.title: One link per widget
obs.text: Add it as a Browser Source. Changes show up live, no refresh needed.

emotes.title: 7TV, BetterTTV and FFZ
emotes.text: Third-party emotes work out of the box, including zero-width ones.

styles.title: Styles and animations
styles.text: Start from a preset, make it yours and save it as your own style.

editor.noStyles: Tweak the fields below and save them as your own style.
editor.confirmRegenerate: Generate a new link? The old one will stop working in OBS.
editor.obsStep1: In OBS add a new source: Browser.
editor.obsStep2: Paste the link and set the size to {width} × {height}.
editor.obsStep3: For alert sounds, tick “Control audio via OBS”.

css.intro: Your CSS applies only to this widget. Click a class to add it to the editor, click a variable to copy it.
css.variables: CSS variables (values from the Style tab)

hints.hideAfter: 0 keeps messages until new ones push them out.
hints.ignoredUsers: Bots and users whose messages are hidden. Press Enter after each name.
hints.text: Leave empty for the default. Tokens: {'{name}'} {'{count}'} {'{months}'} {'{tier}'}. Plural: {'{count|sub|subs}'}.
hints.textResub: Used when months is greater than 1. Leave empty for the default.
hints.min: Smaller amounts don't trigger an alert.
hints.minMessages: Same emote in this many different messages.
hints.countdownTo: Local time. Leave empty to hide the countdown.
hints.title: Leave empty for the default text for the selected mode.
hints.sceneBackground: 3D looks great but uses the GPU. Pick a lighter background if your game stutters.

sound.loginToUpload: Connect an account to upload sounds
sound.invalidUrl: Enter a link starting with https://

errors.login_required: Connect an account to upload sounds
errors.too_many_sounds: You've reached the limit of 30 sounds
errors.too_large: The file is larger than 3 MB

cssClasses.root: Whole widget area (holds all CSS variables)
cssClasses.chatPlatformAttr: Messages from one platform only (twitch or kick)
cssClasses.alertText: Container for the name and message
cssClasses.sceneBackground: Gradient or glowing orbs in the background
